From Bastet · Price: the target must touch your trap first.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 10 minutes: plant a magnet trap. A creature that touches it is magnetized: metal objects stick to it (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} if it wears metal armor).
  • 5: Magnetism grows each round: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 2} after 3 rounds.
  • 9: Surge: pull every unattended metal object within 30 ft onto the magnetized creature: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 13: You can magnetize a creature your stand hits (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 17: A magnetized creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} against metal surfaces.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
